err.option_locked: Your department has fixed this option, so you can't change it.
err.option_value: That choice isn't available for this option.
err.option_config: An officer option here is unknown or has a value it can't take.
options.subtitle: Set the tablet up for yourself. Every change saves on its own.
options.chip.server_hint: Saved with this character, on any PC.
options.chip.local_hint: Kept on this PC only, for every character you play here.
options.locked_text: An admin has turned officer options off on this server, so everyone keeps the defaults.
options.look.title: Tablet look and privacy
options.keys.title: My keys
options.keys.hint: Change them in GTA Settings > Key Bindings > FiveM.
options.key.hudSide_hint: The side of the screen the mission HUD sits on. Notifications stay top right.
options.key.hudScale_hint: 1 is the normal size; it still grows and shrinks with your screen.
options.key.hudCompact_hint: Show only the current objective, how many are done and the timer.
options.key.reduceMotion_hint: The HUD and notifications appear without sliding in or flashing.
options.key.hudLook: Use my tablet look on the HUD
options.key.hudLook_hint: The mission HUD, the result card and notifications use your tablet look and accent instead of the department colours.
options.key.textSize_hint: Large text makes the words on the tablet and the mission HUD bigger.
options.key.toastTime_hint: How long notifications stay on screen. Warnings and errors stay a little longer.
options.key.resultTime_hint: Seconds the mission result card stays on screen. You can always close it sooner.
options.key.quietRun_hint: During a mission, unit invites, commendations, rewards and profile news go only to the bell. Route, custody and mission messages, warnings and errors still pop up.
options.key.soundCalls_hint: Play a tone when a new mission call pops up. Off: the call still pops up, silently.
options.key.soundUnit_hint: Play a tone for a unit invite and a ready check. Off: they still pop up, silently.
options.key.soundCues_hint: Play a short cue on a mission when you pass a checkpoint, defuse a target or find an item.
err.option_hide_all: You can't hide every mission type: keep at least one on the board.
options.key.favouriteTypes_hint: These mission types come first on the Mission Board, in the board's order.
options.key.hiddenTypes_hint: These mission types fold under Hidden types at the bottom of the board. You can still open and accept them.
options.key.skipAcceptConfirm_hint: Accept starts a mission type at once and the warnings show under the cards. To add twists, use the Twists button on the card. The Weekly Boss still asks first.
options.key.usualTwists_hint: These twists start ticked when you take a mission from the Mission Board or claim a mission call, where that mission offers them. You can still untick them. When you pick any, they replace the twists your department ticks.
options.key.skipClaimConfirm_hint: Claim on a mission call takes it at once and the warnings show under the calls. To add twists, use the Twists button on the call. If several units claim together, the nearest still wins.
options.key.callAlerts_hint: Favourite types only: a new call pops up only for your favourite mission types (Mission Board). Every call still shows on Dispatch. With no favourite types picked, every call pops up. To silence all calls, use Mute call alerts on Dispatch.
options.key.dispatchKeyAfterCall: Tablet key opens Dispatch after a call
options.key.dispatchKeyAfterCall_hint: For 20 seconds after a mission call pops up, the tablet key opens the tablet on Dispatch. Nothing is claimed.
options.key.openOn_hint: The screen the tablet opens on. On a mission: Active Mission while you are on a run, Unit while a ready check waits for you, otherwise the last screen.
options.key.rememberFilters_hint: Dispatch and the Leaderboard open with the filters you used last time on this PC.
options.key.abandonConfirm_hint: Off: no dialog. Abandon turns into Click again to abandon for 3 seconds, so it still takes two presses. Abandoning still puts the mission type on cooldown.
options.key.skipRecalcConfirm_hint: Recalculate route draws the new route at once, without asking. It still uses one of your recalculations.
options.key.autoReady_hint: When your unit leader accepts a mission type, you are Ready at once while you are at the keys and near the leader. Far away, in the pause menu or idle for a minute, you answer yourself. Not ready still works.
options.key.distanceUnits_hint: How distances read on the mission HUD, Active Mission and Dispatch on this PC.
options.key.keyHints_hint: Name the key bound to it: "or press K" on the ready check, "F6 opens Dispatch" on a new mission call and the contact key on the contact HUD line. A key you have not bound is never named.
options.key.objectiveGps_hint: How the map leads you to each objective once you are at the action. Radio Silence still hides it, and the drive to the start keeps its own route.
options.value.objectiveGps.off: Nothing (the Objective GPS button still sets one)
options.key.hudTargetLine_hint: The mission HUD names the objective your map points to and how far it is.
options.key.colourblindMap_hint: Objective blips and the GPS line use blue, yellow, orange, white and purple on this PC, never red or green. Enemies are purple.
